evals.prompt: 查一下精确字符串 `search_auto_test_on_launch_v1` 最早出自哪个项目，给出 commit-pinned 代码链接并核验 fork/rename 关系。
evals.expected_output: Uses search_auto in exact mode (avoiding semantic-only Exa), cites commit-pinned code, and resolves or explicitly reports repository-origin ambiguity.
expectations: Uses search_auto with mode exact (or Parallel/Brave/Serper directly), and does not route exact-string lookup directly to Exa.
Provides a commit-pinned source URL containing the exact string.
Checks repository identity or fork/rename ambiguity before naming the original project.
Does not add a routing footer, because the user did not ask for one.

evals.prompt: 查一下今天的新加坡 AI 创业新闻，最多给 5 条候选来源，不要使用豆包，也不要启动深度研究。
evals.expected_output: Uses compact current-mode retrieval, returns at most five sources with their dates, and avoids Doubao and deep research.
expectations: Uses search_auto with mode current (which leads with You.com, Exa news, and Octen).
Returns no more than five source URLs.
Does not use or cite Doubao and does not start deep research.

evals.prompt: 直接读取 https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/tools 并概括 ToolAnnotations；不要重新搜索这个已知 URL，也不要调用本机不存在的 Jina Reader 或 TinyFish Browser。
evals.expected_output: Fetches the known URL directly with fetch_auto, summarizes ToolAnnotations, and neither searches the URL nor invents unavailable tools.
expectations: Summarizes readOnlyHint and destructiveHint from the requested page.
Uses fetch_auto, or a direct fetch/scrape tool, rather than a search query.
Does not claim to call Jina Reader or TinyFish Browser.

evals.prompt: 帮我研究一下为什么 AI Agent 的网页回答需要 grounding chunks，而不只是搜索摘要。我想让模型直接基于多来源正文回答，控制在约 4096 token；不要启动深度研究，也不要逐页抓取。
evals.expected_output: Uses search_auto in context mode or brave_llm_context with an explicit 4096 token cap and avoids separate page fetches and deep research.
expectations: Uses search_auto in context mode, or brave_llm_context directly with maximumNumberOfTokens set to 4096 (not its 8192 direct default).
Keeps the grounding budget at approximately 4096 tokens.
Does not start deep research or separately fetch each result page.
Uses the returned per-source grounding as evidence rather than treating snippets as a finished answer.

evals.prompt: 快速查一下今天同一个主题的网页资料和新闻报道，希望一次调用拿到两类结果，并返回适合模型引用的相关段落；不要做深度研究。
evals.expected_output: Uses You.com unified Web/News search with query-aware highlights and avoids deep research.
expectations: Uses you_search.
Requests highlights only because query-aware passages were explicitly requested.
Uses both Web and News results when both are returned.
Does not start deep research or fetch every result separately.

evals.prompt: 我要找一组适合 AI Agent 使用的网页检索服务，目标是比较近期官方能力、延迟取舍和给模型使用的正文片段。请把目标拆成 2 到 3 条短查询后一次检索，不要逐页抓取。
evals.expected_output: Uses Parallel Search with a semantic objective and concise search queries and consumes the ranked excerpts.
expectations: Uses parallel_search.
Supplies a self-contained objective plus 2-3 concise searchQueries.
Uses returned excerpts before considering any page fetch.
Does not start deep research or fetch every result separately.

evals.prompt: 有人说某家公司本周宣布了重大收购。我要两个互相独立的检索来源来互相印证，别只信一个搜索引擎，也别做深度研究。
evals.expected_output: Runs one cross-checked current search across two independent indexes and reports which results were corroborated.
expectations: Uses search_auto with crossCheck true and current mode, rather than two unrelated manual searches.
Distinguishes results found by both providers from results found by one.
Does not treat several reposts of one report as independent confirmation.
Does not start deep research.

evals.prompt: 这个页面是重度 JavaScript 渲染的单页应用，普通抓取读不到正文：https://example.com/app 。请把正文读出来，最多 8000 字符。
evals.expected_output: Reads the known URL with fetch_auto at max quality and a character cap.
expectations: Uses fetch_auto with quality max, or Firecrawl scrape directly.
Sets the character cap to about 8000.
Does not search for the URL it already has.

evals.prompt: 只在 modelcontextprotocol.io 和 github.com 这两个域名内搜索 MCP Streamable HTTP 会话管理的资料，排除 reddit.com，返回最多 5 条。
evals.expected_output: Uses search_auto with includeDomains and excludeDomains rather than manually calling multiple single-provider tools.
expectations: Uses search_auto with includeDomains set to modelcontextprotocol.io and github.com, and excludeDomains set to reddit.com.
Caps limit at 5.
Does not start deep research.

evals.prompt: 一次性读取 https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/transports 和 https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/tools 这两个已知页面的 Security Considerations 章节。
evals.expected_output: Uses a single batch fetch_auto call with urls and section filtering.
expectations: Calls fetch_auto once with urls containing both known URLs.
Passes section set to Security Considerations to extract the relevant heading section.
Does not run a search query for URLs it already has.

evals.prompt: 只在 github.com/modelcontextprotocol 路径下找 StreamableHTTPServerTransport 的用法和示例，返回 5 条即可。
evals.expected_output: Uses search_auto in code mode with includeDomains preserving the github.com/modelcontextprotocol path prefix.
expectations: Uses search_auto with mode code and includeDomains set to github.com/modelcontextprotocol.
Caps limit around 5.
Does not use deprecated category github.

evals.prompt: 帮我反搜这张公开图片的来源和最早出现页面：https://example.com/photo.jpg 。另外，我电脑桌面上的 local.png 也能直接传进去以图搜图吗？
evals.expected_output: Uses search_images with imageUrl for the public URL and clearly explains that local files cannot be searched by image without a public http(s) URL.
expectations: Uses search_images with imageUrl set to https://example.com/photo.jpg.
Notes that Google Lens does not prove earliest publication date without checking source pages.
States clearly that local files cannot be searched by image unless hosted at a public http(s) URL.

evals.prompt: 帮我读取 https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/models-and-providers/web-search 的 Using DeepSeek Search 这一节，用常规均衡模式即可。
evals.expected_output: Uses fetch_auto in balanced mode with section filtering so zero-cost native Markdown or balanced readers answer first.
expectations: Uses fetch_auto with url and section set to Using DeepSeek Search.
Keeps quality at balanced rather than escalating unnecessarily to max or Firecrawl.
Does not run a search query for the known URL.

evals.prompt: 帮我查一下 @vercel 最近在 X 上有没有发过关于 AI Gateway 的动态，快速确认一下就行。
evals.expected_output: Uses grok_x_search at depth fast for a quick X lookup without escalating to expensive multi-agent depth max.
expectations: Uses grok_x_search with allowedXHandles targeting vercel.
Keeps depth at fast rather than burning multi-agent research credits on depth max.
Treats X search as the right tool only because X posts themselves were requested.

evals.prompt: Find the most-cited survey papers on retrieval-augmented generation and report their citation counts.
evals.expected_output: Uses scholar retrieval and calls serper_scholar directly when citation counts are explicitly required, without using deprecated Exa pdf category.
expectations: Uses serper_scholar directly (or search_auto mode scholar followed by serper_scholar) because citation counts were explicitly requested.
Does not pass deprecated Exa category pdf or a tbs filter to serper_scholar.
Keeps result count compact and avoids deep research.

evals.prompt: You are connected to a lean-profile Search Toolkit server and need to map all documentation pages under https://docs.example.com. Show the exact sequence of tool calls.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the exposed provider tool name and input schema via provider_tools before calling provider_call with firecrawl_firecrawl_map (never guessing phantom names like firecrawl_map).
expectations: Calls provider_tools first to discover the exact exposed tool name and input schema.
Calls provider_call using the real exposed tool name (firecrawl_firecrawl_map) rather than an unprefixed or invented name.
Does not call firecrawl_crawl or other phantom tool names.

evals.prompt: Where is `isUsableFetchText` defined in my local repository, and what changed in the commit I just pushed 30 seconds ago? Also, if a tool permission prompt is denied by the user, should you silently switch to another web tool?
evals.expected_output: Uses local rg or gh search code for local/freshly-pushed code instead of web search, and confirms a permission denial is not tool unavailability.
expectations: Uses local rg (or file search) and gh rather than web search for local or freshly pushed code.
Explicitly states that a user permission denial is not tool unavailability and must not be bypassed by switching to another route.

evals.prompt: Read the full contents of a very long specification at https://example.com/long-spec. The first fetch_auto call returned readable text truncated with nextOffset=12000; another URL returned page.status='partial'. How should you proceed for each?
evals.expected_output: Continues reading the truncated readable page using offset=12000, and escalates the partial page to quality='max' rather than trusting a fragment.
expectations: Calls fetch_auto with offset set to 12000 for the truncated readable URL rather than re-fetching from offset 0.
Treats page.status='partial' as an incomplete fragment and retries with quality='max' (or a specialist reader) if the page matters.

evals.prompt: 刚刚 1 分钟前美联储公布的利率决议结果是什么？如果 search_auto 返回的路由块里带着 `"cached":"4m"`，应该怎么处理？
evals.expected_output: Uses search_auto in current mode, recognizes that cached:4m predates a 1-minute-old announcement, and notes the cache staleness or rephrases (or uses CLI --no-cache).
expectations: Uses search_auto with mode current.
Recognizes that cached:4m means the result was reused from 4 minutes ago and may miss a 1-minute-old event.
States the freshness limitation clearly, rephrases the query, or notes --no-cache in CLI.

evals.prompt: MCP tools are not available in this terminal session on Windows PowerShell. Show how to run a domain-scoped web search, reverse-search an image URL, and invoke `serper_scholar` with JSON arguments via the search-toolkit CLI.
evals.expected_output: Uses search-toolkit search, search-toolkit images, and search-toolkit call with PowerShell-safe --input - or @file.json arguments.
expectations: Uses search-toolkit search with --domains.
Uses search-toolkit images with an image URL (or --image-url).
Uses search-toolkit call serper_scholar with --input - or @args.json (or valid JSON) and avoids operator commands like reset or migrate-config.

evals.prompt: 快速查一下 DeepSeek 官网最新的 API 定价页面地址。注意别花大钱，也别在主搜失败时自作主张用豆包。
evals.expected_output: Uses search_auto in official balanced mode, stays away from expensive jobs like exa_agent_run and grok depth=max, and never falls back to Doubao.
expectations: Uses search_auto with mode official and balanced quality.
Does not call exa_agent_run, grok depth=max, or deep research.
Does not call doubao_search as a primary or fallback tool.

evals.prompt: Use AnySearch to run a vertical vulnerability lookup for a CVE ID.
evals.expected_output: Calls anysearch_get_sub_domains first to obtain valid sub_domain and parameter fields before calling anysearch_search.
expectations: Calls anysearch_get_sub_domains before calling anysearch_search with vertical parameters.
Uses only the sub_domain and parameter schema returned by anysearch_get_sub_domains rather than guessing values.
